mapper.insert: insert into farmer_access (user_id, village_id, farm_name, id_card, type) values (#{userId},#{villageId},#{farmName},#{idCard},#{type})
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM village_base WHERE manage_id = #{manageId} LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id AS id, u.username AS username, u.phone AS phone, fu.village_id AS villageId, fu.farm_name AS farmName, fu.type AS type, fu.status AS status, fu.create_time AS createTime, fu.update_time AS updateTime FROM farm_user fu INNER JOIN user u ON fu.user_id = u.id WHERE fu.village_id = #{villageId}
SELECT village_id FROM farm_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = 2 LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id AS id, u.username AS username, u.phone AS phone, fu.farm_name AS farmName, fu.village_id AS villageId, fu.status AS status, fu.type AS type, fu.update_time AS updateTime, fu.create_time AS createTime FROM farm_user fu JOIN user u ON fu.user_id = u.id WHERE fu.village_id = #{villageId} AND fu.type = 1

SELECT fa.id, fa.user_id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.phone AS phone, fa.village_id AS villageId, fa.farm_name AS farmName, fa.id_card AS idCard, fa.type, fa.status, fa.create_time FROM farmer_access fa JOIN user u ON fa.user_id = u.id WHERE fa.village_id = #{villageId} ORDER BY fa.id DESC

SELECT u.id AS id, u.username AS username, u.phone AS phone, fu.farm_name AS farmName, fu.village_id AS villageId, fu.status AS status, fu.type AS type, fu.update_time AS updateTime, fu.create_time AS createTime FROM farm_user fu JOIN user u ON fu.user_id = u.id

SELECT fa.id, fa.user_id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.phone AS phone, fa.village_id AS villageId, fa.farm_name AS farmName, fa.id_card AS idCard, fa.type, fa.status, fa.create_time FROM farmer_access fa JOIN user u ON fa.user_id = u.id ORDER BY fa.id DESC
